evals.name: cross-family-default-uses-all-three-reviewers
evals.prompt: Review these staged changes adversarially before I merge them.
evals.expected_output: Uses the default cross-family strategy with Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini reviewer paths when available, and returns a PASS, CONTESTED, or REJECT verdict.

evals.name: native-provider-strategy-is-explicitly-opt-in
evals.prompt: Review this provider-specific runtime claim using the provider's own reviewer path.
evals.expected_output: Treats native-provider as an explicit option, not the default, and still grounds the claim in current docs plus a local probe when needed.

evals.name: codex-host-subagent-inherits-parent-sandbox-not-absolute-readonly
evals.prompt: Review the Codex host reviewer path and its isolation claim.
evals.expected_output: Describes the fresh Codex subagent as inheriting the parent sandbox and approval state, does not overclaim read-only isolation, and records the correct Codex reviewer path.

evals.name: claude-oauth-compatible-reviewer-does-not-require-api-key
evals.prompt: Review the Claude Code reviewer path when the user is logged in with OAuth.
evals.expected_output: Uses the OAuth-compatible scripted reviewer path with explicit read/search and session constraints, and does not require API-key-only --bare mode unless explicitly requested.

evals.name: gemini-plan-mode-is-not-inherently-readonly
evals.prompt: Review the Gemini reviewer path in plan mode.
evals.expected_output: Does not call --approval-mode plan inherently read-only, and documents copy sandbox, memory, plan, and session caveats explicitly.

evals.name: architecture-plan-keeps-architect-lens
evals.prompt: Challenge this refactor plan before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Keeps an Architect review, surfaces migration or coupling risks, and synthesizes accepted versus rejected findings.

evals.name: simplification-review-keeps-minimalist-lens
evals.prompt: Tell me whether this proposed rewrite is overengineered.
evals.expected_output: Keeps a Minimalist review, calls out unnecessary machinery when justified, and distinguishes real issues from optional cleanup.

evals.name: invalid-strategy-name-is-classified-as-input_error
evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review with strategy name `sidecar`.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the invalid strategy as INPUT_ERROR instead of trying to guess a fallback.

evals.name: claude-turn-limit-is-reported-explicitly
evals.prompt: Run the Claude reviewer with a turn cap low enough to stop the review early.
evals.expected_output: Reports TURN_LIMIT explicitly instead of pretending the review completed normally.

evals.name: gemini-failure-reduces-diversity-but-does-not-collapse-review
evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review even if Gemini is missing or rate-limited.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently drop the failed reviewer, continues when Codex and Claude completed successfully, and records reduced reviewer diversity in the verdict.

evals.name: timeout-is-reported-explicitly
evals.prompt: Run the review wrappers with a timeout short enough to force a timeout.
evals.expected_output: Reports TIMEOUT explicitly instead of hanging or silently truncating the run.

evals.name: malformed-output-is-reported-explicitly
evals.prompt: Simulate a reviewer CLI that emits malformed or empty output.
evals.expected_output: Reports MALFORMED_OUTPUT explicitly and does not pretend the reviewer succeeded.

evals.name: runtime-claim-needs-doc-or-local-evidence
evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review and one reviewer claims a CLI flag does not exist.
evals.expected_output: Rejects or demotes the claim unless it matches current docs or local CLI evidence, and records the evidence gap in synthesis.

evals.name: nongit-codex-fallback-still-runs
evals.prompt: Run the Codex fallback reviewer against a directory that is not a git repo.
evals.expected_output: Uses the non-git fallback path and still produces a classified success or failure result.
